notes.title: v1.0.6 FIXED bug when player got stuck in table + minor fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]FIX: Sometimes you could be stuck in a table or similar when returning from a puzzle and opened the inventory/diary. Solved.
[*]FIX: One puzzle solution was reflected in the guard booth crystal. Solved.
[*]FIX: You should not be able to grab the red keycard from the Investigation Room. Solved
[/list]
